_policy: train_v1_open = Apache-2.0 open weights. Included: public-domain, permissive and share-alike sources. Curated material without an explicit open licence (official school textbooks, curator-provided volumes) and one research-use parallel corpus (OPUS OpenSubtitles) were admitted per source by curator decision on 2026-08-28 and are recorded as such; NC/ND-licensed sources were excluded. No source text is redistributed.
